description: Compiler acceptance tasks; required fields are partial expectations, not outputs observed from a model. Preserve explicit wording, preview interpretations/losses, and require normal owner approval. No extra medical approval flow.

cases.source:
## What I read
I have ADHD. Keep that exact statement in my note. Start with a TL;DR.

## Ce que je lis
Mes médicaments me ralentissent le matin. Je veux garder cette phrase telle quelle dans ma note.

required_proposal_fields.notes: Mes médicaments me ralentissent le matin.

cases.source:
## What I read
Number your steps. End with one small next step for me, and no recap of what you just did. No idioms.

## What I decide
Ask so that I can just say yes to your pick.

## When to interrupt me
On long tasks, tell me where you are only when a phase changes.

## When to interrupt me
Don't interrupt me after 7 pm or before 8 am, Paris time, and not at all on weekends.
required_preview_facts: The time zone Europe/Paris indicates an approximate location and is shared under the selected visibility
